scope: fixed workstation; apparatus commands; shared demonstration-derived motor skills
public_action: announce and advance all four indicators from version zero to version one after initial inspection
shared_current_observations: Three RGB camera views produced by the simulator; head RGB used by the diagnostic reader
shared_motor_library: One frozen four-slot library, calibrated once before evaluation
recovery_trigger: missing or unreadable evidence whose version remains current according to public action records
recovery_update: Recovered image is transient; queries are unique; persistent memory is frozen during the query phase
unknown_answer: abstain; scored incorrect, separately logged as missing evidence
control_gate: All eight initial cue reads correct, all covers reclosed, zero forbidden API calls
budget_audit: persistent RGB payload and JSON metadata recorded after each update; candidate insertion transient is separate
limitations: Evaluation seeds change colours, not workstation geometry
Public indicator advance is not a learned 14-DoF manipulation
Oldest-first is a required action-blind comparator
Eight queries in one episode are not eight independent scene samples
No EventVLA weights or cache behaviour are evaluated by this fixed-skill controller
